resources.string: Stops feed swipes in YouTube Shorts, YouTube ReVanced, Instagram Reels, and TikTok. Reads visible interface elements, including playback controls, only on your device and places a transparent layer over short-video feeds. Horizontal drags on a recognized playback bar can seek within the video. While TikTok protection is visible, Back buttons and gestures open recent apps instead of changing videos. You can optionally protect every screen in a selected app.
If a video is not detected

Compatibility mode blocks drags on every screen of the selected app, including its regular feed and messages. Recognized playback bars still allow horizontal seeking. Use it only when video detection does not work.
Protect every screen in this app

A transparent layer stops feed swipes. Horizontal drags on a recognized playback bar can seek within the video, and short taps pass through. In TikTok, Back buttons, Back gestures, and the top banner open recent apps so you can choose the sending app. In other apps, the banner goes Back.
The service reads the visible interface only on your device. It does not save your viewing history or video content, and it does not send them anywhere.
Access is on. Open a short video in a selected app.

NeverScroll uses an accessibility service to detect short-video screens in YouTube, YouTube ReVanced, Instagram, and TikTok. On those screens it reads visible interface labels and playback controls, including controls normally omitted from accessibility, and intercepts touches to stop feed swipes. Short taps are passed to the original app through an accessible click or a replayed tap. Horizontal drags on a recognized playback bar are replayed to seek within the video. Data stays on your device: it is not saved or sent anywhere. While TikTok protection is visible, Back buttons, Back gestures, and the top banner open recent apps because Back can change the video. If you enable compatibility mode, feed swipes are blocked on every screen of the selected app, and Back opens recent apps on every screen of TikTok. You can turn off the service in Android settings at any time.
